overview: At dusk you looked at the almanac on the sill. The thirtieth of March carried the mark of the new moon. Your tables stayed shut, and you wrote nothing.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked at the March leaf and left the tables shut.

assets.name: the penny almanac
assets.disposition: Saw the new moon marked and closed the almanac

summary: Saw the new moon marked and closed the almanac
